title: Members | 1. FC Union Berlin
content: A fan holds a red scarf saying "For members" high in a stadium. ## Club. FC Union Berlin, you are more than just a fan – you are an essential part of our club. ## Determine and shape the future of our club with us. Logo of the football club 1. FC Union Berlin form the foundation for our club life and regulate the essential aspects of organization and membership. They define the goals of the club, including the promotion of sports and community, and provide a legal framework for our actions. The statutes stipulate how decisions are made, how the various committees operate, and how our members can actively participate in club life. ## Our team for you. Our fan affairs team is just the right place for you. Actively shape the club life and join our FuMA. The diverse aspects from the fan environment are intensely discussed and worked on in various working groups with the aim of initiating new ideas and projects.

title: 1. FC Union Berlin - Wikipedia
content: Association football club in Germany. This article is about the men's football club. For the women's team, see 1. FC Union Berlin (women) "1. During the Cold War, Union was based in East Berlin, joining the German league structure upon the reunification of the country in 1990. In 2019, Union won promotion to the Bundesliga for the first time in the club's history. The following season, the club qualified for the Champions League for the first time in their history, by finishing fourth in the Bundesliga. The home ground of the club is the Stadion An der Alten Försterei. FC Union Berlin was used by two football clubs that shared a common origin as *FC Olympia Oberschöneweide*, founded in 1906 in Oberschöneweide, which at that time was a suburb of Berlin. 1. FC Union Berlin was founded during the reorganization of East German football in December 1965 and January 1966, when ten dedicated football clubs "Football club (East Germany)") were created.
